question: Does current V2 evidence establish a controlled ISS-failure -> weakness classification -> bounded treatment -> controlled evaluation feedback loop, or what exact link remains missing?

evidence: src/skatai/evaluation/bidding_weakness.py and src/skatai/evaluation/cardplay_weakness.py implement bounded weakness diagnostics.
Current provenance contains multiple preserved bidding/cardplay diagnostic results and negative findings.
The R9 ISS gate captures live external gameplay evidence with persistent ledgers.
No current source path automatically converts classified external failures into a leakage-safe bounded treatment experiment and hands that experiment to a controlled evaluation/promotion lifecycle.

decision: REJECT current closed-loop acceptance. Failure evidence and diagnostic modules exist, but the external-failure classifier -> bounded treatment -> experiment -> evaluation feedback link is not yet automated and demonstrated.

missing_capability.primary: A deterministic external-failure mining pipeline with leakage boundaries and experiment handoff.
required_properties: failure taxonomy from Work Prompt phase 14
bounded treatment proposal with explicit causal hypothesis
outcome linkage back to the originating weakness without training on protected holdout results

next_action: Implement the failure-mining registry and experiment handoff, then demonstrate one preserved ISS failure flowing through classification to a bounded non-promoted treatment evaluation.
